name: DOB Certificate Of Occupancy
description:
This dataset contains records of certificates of occupancy issued by the New York City Department of Buildings, covering 5,000 sampled permits across 25 fields. Each row represents a certificate of occupancy tied to a construction job, identified by job number, job type (new building or alteration), and issue date. Records include the certificate type (temporary or final), property identifiers such as BIN, BBL, block, lot, and house number, along with street name, borough, and postcode. Geographic fields include latitude and longitude, community board, council district, census tract, and neighborhood tabulation area, enabling mapping and neighborhood-level analysis. Dwelling unit counts are provided for proposed and existing units, though these fields are often missing. All sampled records show an application status of "Issued" and a filing status of "New," so those columns offer little variation within this sample.

The data can support analyses of construction and development activity over time and by borough or neighborhood, studies of housing unit
